evidence.text: Participants were assigned by a computer-generated sequence using variable blocks.
The independent service released the next allocation after eligibility was recorded.
Participants and treating clinicians could see the assigned intervention.
The primary analysis includes every randomised participant.
Complete registry follow-up was obtained for the five withdrawals.
The outcome assessor was unaware of allocation.
A blinded adjudicator classified vital status using the protocol definition.
The primary estimand is the effect of assignment to intervention A on all-cause mortality at 30 days.
The primary time point is 30 days. A 12-month estimate is exploratory.
